notes.title: Anniversary Sail: 75% Off!
notes.content:
Ahoy Mateys!

[b]HAPPY 1st BIRTHDAY to our baby SAIL and SACRIFICE!![/b] Our longest game development journey so far of 2.5 years. In honor of our 1 year anniversary and Steam Summer SAIL, the game will be available today for just [b]$5 = 75% off[/b]!

[b]Sail and Sacrifice[/b] brings ye into an [b]open world RPG of pirates, natives, and Spaniards! Explore 25 islands[/b] with yer crew and decide an end to the war for The Archipelago. We’re so proud of what we’ve achieved, though be aware of performance issues on some machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31949143/34ef356f00089ffe62faca31f847e4c81ca70be0.png[/img]

Our team of 2 has been hard at work on many games since then, and have grown so much in the past year. We are proud and excited to introduce the [b]FREE [/b]alpha version of our [b]latest project: SHERWOOD EXTREME![/b] A high-speed, casual shooter where you save the kingdom as a hobby and challenge other players in beautiful low-poly environments.

Wishlist on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340180/Sherwood_Extreme]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1340180/Sherwood_Extreme[/url]
Play for FREE on Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/aeF2jEn]https://discord.com/invite/aeF2jEn[/url]

Happy sailing, we hope to meet you on Discord!

Later, Landlubbers!
- Gabriel & Salaar

notes.title: Gunpowder Patch 1.3 Released!
notes.content:

Ahoy me maties! Tales of explosive adventure await those who play the latest update of "Sail and Sacrifice". Gunpowder has now been implemented in a variety of ways including the flintlock pistol, picking up explosive barrels, throwing them, and shooting them. Here's an overview of what we've done in the last patch:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/588cf49d2b8cc2b42e6616db40688b9219adcca0.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Explosive barrels can now be picked up, kicked around, thrown, and sniped in slow-motion.
[*] Added Flintlock Pistol.
[*] Added inventory and quests to journal menu
[*] Beginning prison has improved tutorials.
[*] Many bug fixes, frame-rate and loading time improvements
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/3adf4862ba8a8fbdcaf8dd02c403999c496ae6dd.png[/img]

notes.title: Melee Combat 2.0 Patch 1.2 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.2 - Melee Combat 2.0[/h1]
Ahoy landlubbers! Thar be boons in store for those who play the latest update of "Sail and Sacrifice," especially ye sword enthusiasts. Melee Combat 2.0 includes intuitive targeting, building tension through the "Riposte Meter" and executing your foes via a variety of ways. Here's an overview of what we've done since the last patch:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/79ba4970d0f248eb8733d0494ca83dd42d0a2b0d.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the "gentleman's rule" where NPCs are only allowed to engage in 1 on 1 duels
[*] Added target aiming system with slow motion to better select your enemy
[*] Added the "Riposte" meter, which builds up through defensive combat gameplay and can be spent on heavy attack counters and disarming your opponents
[*] Removed stamina costs from parrying and melee attacks
[*] Added dense fog to underwater
[*] Added a 3D treasure chime sound when the player is near a chest
[*] Reduced the range of fish wildlife to account for underwater fog, increasing density
[*] Redistributed probabilities of small fish versus larger ones
[*] Made horizontal turning rate slower when facing an NPC
[*] Adjusted minimum and maximum viewing angles on the player character camera
[*] Many bug fixes, frame-rate and loading time improvements
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/b6f52e3c1a38e70e45ab0cd345c815e86a63383a.png[/img]

notes.title: Character Customization Patch 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.1 - Character Customization[/h1]
Ahoy pirates, Kalinago natives and Spaniards! We've been hard at work fixing bugs, implementing new features and polishing the overall quality of Sail and Sacrifice in our latest patch 1.1. Your feedback has been immensely valuable as we continue to grow and improve our game. Here's a sneak peak at our most requested feature - Character Customization:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/51a5741270208b08e7fcb545a033fd9b9edb5bf6.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added male and female character customization
[*] Added manual save to pause menu
[*] Added a repair option to “Improve my ship” menu
[*] Ship health bar now shows by repair ship option in the "Improve my ship" menu
[*] Added music volume control
[*] Added neck rotation based on camera angle to the player
[*] Added crew menu scrolling with the left joystick
[*] Ships now spawn at least one loot chest
[*] Allies should no longer be able to attack surrendered enemies
[*] Fixed weapon trading and exchanging with NPCs
[*] Boost on boats no longer requires forward (W or left joystick) to be held
[*] Chests now only give wood or cotton as resources
[*] Fixed game saving/loading
[*] Fixed control remapping from WASD
[*] Crew menu now populates correctly
[*] Fixed many bugs with level design and NPCs
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/e5451bb68380f61b771d21c97372a0faed87d9d8.png[/img]

Please continue to provide us with feedback of what you love and what you’d like to see next - We are very active on our Discord and Steam forums and hope to meet you there!

notes.title: Early Access Patch 10
notes.content:
We've been hard at work for months developing tons of new content, rpg mechanics, fixing bugs and are excited to share some of what we've added to [i]Sail and Sacrifice[/i]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/35977efc0a613c3e893ca5674fc76ce2cd59df1a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Main storyline including new starting quests to guide your adventure!
[*] Photo mode - capture the action with custom camera settings and filters
[*] Revamped combat system featuring enemy dodges, rolls, and parries
[*] Boat purchase and upgrade menus for custom perks and appearances
[*] Customize your glider’s flag and dye by visiting tailors across the world
[*] Free prisoners from cages to have them join your crew
[*] Loading screens added so game never appears frozen on load
[*] Intuitive tutorial icons on the side of the screen
[*] Dozens of bugfixes and animation improvements
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31949143/082510b9c0474b5cb50fffdc57044c9ea3471df8.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Patch 6
notes.content:
[list]
[*]We just changed the starting gameplay to a [b]playable stormy naval battle[/b]! Press new game and experience Sail and Sacrifice with a new start.
[*]The Archipelago is now [b]rich with wildlife[/b], from penguins and cassowaries to frogs and spiders, many of which you can interact with.
[*]Our [b]new crew management system[/b] allows you to change wages to choose your first mate and get new crew titles. Steal gold from your crew but risk them shunning you.
[*]Other changes include [b]pirate shanties[/b] while sailing, [b]female characters[/b] with female names and voices, improved boat cameras and icons, loading screens, and hundreds more gameplay bugfixes.
[/list]

Our [b]new crew management system[/b] allows you to change wages to choose your first mate and get new crew titles. Steal gold from your crew but risk them shunning you.

Other changes include [b]pirate shanties[/b] while sailing, [b]female characters[/b] with female names and voices, improved boat cameras and icons, loading screens, and hundreds more gameplay bugfixes.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 5
notes.content:
This patch features our BEST performance improvement yet! If this version doesn't run on your computer, please let us know.
-[b]Naval boarding system:[/b] reel in enemy ships with your harpoon gun, hop on board, and kill the enemy captain to steal the ship, its loot, and new crew members!
-Added [b]chest counter[/b] for locations and ships
-Swap between [b]day/night/sunset[/b] at campfires
-Improved progression and save functionality
-Fixed artifacts (Solwe's Light, etc)
-Hundreds of gameplay and audio bugfixes
